segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, somewhat sensitive skin says it worked wonders for acne, while another with oily skin reports it left her super dry with peeling and a bad breakout.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer describes a severe allergic reaction with hives and rash across the face and neck, and does not recommend the product for sensitive skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the moisturizer in the set kept her skin feeling healthy, not tight or oily.
segments.mature: A 55-year-old reviewer who has struggled with pimples her whole life and a 38-year-old with hormonal acne both report improved skin using the routine.

concerns.spots: Several reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts within a week or over continued use, including one describing zero breakouts; one reviewer with oily skin reports the opposite, a bad breakout after use.
concerns.blemishes: One long-time hormonal acne sufferer reports her skin looks the best it has in two years, though she still gets occasional stubborn closed comedones; a 55-year-old reports pimples improved noticeably.
concerns.aging: One 38-year-old reviewer reports the serum faded post-acne hyperpigmentation as part of the set's effect on her skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports a severe reaction causing hives and rash on the face and neck, requiring multiple doctor visits.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with oily skin reports her skin became super dry with peeling around the nose after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with dry skin reports the moisturizer kept her skin from feeling oily; another with oily skin found the routine refreshing and suited to her skin.

aspects.libelle: Formula and packaging changed for the worse

extraits.texte: I do not recommend this product for sensitive skin. I had a severe allergic reaction to it, 3 doctor visits later I realized it was these products after several tests. Caused hives/rash all over my face and neck. Tried to return the products and was not able to.
I have oily skin and my skin became super dry, around my nose started peeling, my face broke out bad
I have been using it for a few years now and it feels very refreshing for my skin. I have oily skin and its a bit sensitive, but when I tried this it did wonders for my acne.

Im shocked to see this set has such low ratings. I had never used Tula before, but for the last 2 years ive been struggling with hormonal acne (at 38 years old) and have been trying countless products. Using this set my skin has looked the best it has in 2 years. I still get the occasional stubborn closed comedone, but i also get a professional facial twice a month so my esthetician handles the extractions I can't deal with myself. I highly recommend this set, and its a great price! The moisturizer actually keeps my dry skin feeling healthy -not tight or oily- and the serum has faded so much of my post acne hyperpigmentation!

I have struggled with pimples all of my life. I am 55 and it seems to worse! I bought this to try out. Amazing. My skin has never looked better! It really works super great. I will definitely keep using this routine.
This cleared my face up within a week! My skin feels smooth and less textured with zero breakouts. Highly recommend!

A few years back Tula products were phenomenal. The company has changed the formulations, shrunk the packaging, and raised the prices! Unfortunately I won't but Tula anymore but found several alternatives that works.

reserve: Only 8 reviews are available, so the segmentation by skin type and concern rests on a small and largely self-reported sample.
